The theorem negates the canonical within-group unbiasedness assertion instead of proving the canonical conjunction. This is eligible as an actual refutation: its product Bernoulli law is independent and its conditional expectation uses exactly the nonempty-arm event. A two-unit schedule equal to the indicator that both units are treated gives conditional arm mean 1/3 versus marginal mean 1/2 at p=1/2; no first-stage claim is needed to contradict the within-group conjunct.
